entries.alt: Ten distinct women, five seated and five standing, hold lit oil lamps outside a stone building at dusk.
entries.caption: Ten women gather with their lamps to meet the bridegroom. The opening of Jesus' parable brings them together before the delay reveals the difference in their preparation.
entries.findings: Exactly ten women and ten handheld lit lamps remain. Faces now vary clearly in apparent adult age, jawline, nose, cheeks, complexion, hair and expression. Former repeated-model effect is corrected. Hands, lamps, seated/standing anatomy and photographic setting remain coherent. Some look toward the road while seated neighbors converse, fitting an opening gathering rather than a staged uniform gaze.
conditions: Use this actual v2 image, not the rejected original, for subsequent character continuity.
Do not infer which five are wise/foolish merely from seated/standing placement; explicitly fix their identities and oil-vessel preparation in later scenes.
Age and facial diversity are artistic choices, not precise ages or biographies supplied by the text.
continuityMapLeftToRight: Seated blue robe: fuller face, dark hair, warm broad smile.
Seated burgundy robe: slender younger adult face, long nose, dark hair.
Seated olive robe: older gray-haired woman, lined face, gesturing free hand.
Seated cream robe and mauve wrap: darker complexion, short dark curls.
Seated blue robe and beige scarf: mature angular face and dark hair.
Standing cream robe and blue wrap: taller slender woman, long face and dark hair.
Standing ochre robe: short curly brown hair, lined fairer face.
Standing mauve robe: angular middle-aged face, dark hair.
Standing olive robe: fuller dark-complexioned face and smile.
Standing cream robe and brown wrap: older narrow face with gray hair.
